text:
Maria: Quick heads-up — Orcasys renewal ~6 weeks out. We've flagged a steep usage decline across embeddings + reranking since last month. Primary ML lead Priya left and they started a shadow pilot with RivalA. Need quick renewal triage and a salvage plan. :warning:

Jake: Oof. How bad is the drop and which teams are affected?

Maria: 30d telemetry shows token-equivalent calls down ~68%. Active seats fell from 150 -> 44. Top traffic concentrated in workspace 'eng-team' (about ~80% of calls). Renewal target 2026-05-15. Procurement contact Sam (Finance).

Ana: Can you drop the SQL we used so I can replicate?

Maria: Sure — query we ran:

```sql
SELECT workspace_id, SUM(api_calls_30d) as calls_30d, COUNT(DISTINCT user_id) as active_users
FROM usage_events
WHERE customer = 'orcasys'
GROUP BY workspace_id
ORDER BY calls_30d DESC;
```

Results: eng-team = 81% of calls, others nearly idle. Drop lines up with Priya's exit and last month's platform changes.

Dylan: Any billing levers? Committed capacity? Overdue invoices?

Maria: They're on a monthly committed plan with auto-renew, no unpaid invoices. Sam is vetting vendors this quarter. RivalA pilot is a 2-week eval started last week (source: partner intel).

Ana: Two immediate plays: 1) Offer a 30-min technical onboarding for the replacement ML lead — focus on low-friction wins (latency, batching, reranker fidelity). I'll host office hours next Tue. 2) Scope a rollback-safe 10-business-day PoC of the reranker flow with clear KPIs: median latency, cost per 1k queries, and relevance delta.

Jake: I'll re-engage Sam and request intro to the new ML point. Plan: send a short health note today, then schedule Ana's office hours.

Maria: Draft outreach to Sam — please edit:

"Hi Sam — noticed activity drop ahead of your May renewal. Would you be open to a 30-minute technical review with our infra & solutions team to map a low-risk PoC and share a concise usage health snapshot? Available slots: Wed 11am, Thu 3pm. Also happy to tailor to whoever's covering ML now"

Ana: LGTM. Add one sentence asking which capabilities RivalA is testing (latency, price, or model behavior) so we can tailor the PoC.

ops-bot: [intel-alert] RivalA pilot flagged for Orcasys. source=partner_channel. confidence=medium. ts=3765572000.

Dylan: I'll draft a procurement one-pager that highlights SLA tiers, Dedicated capacity benefits, SSO/KMS, and cost/throughput math. Short and visual for Sam.

Maria: Can we enable higher-res telemetry for reranker latency cohorts and run a 7-day comparative analysis? If we can show median <30ms vs RivalA it will be a strong counter.

Ana: I'll create a latency dashboard and run cohort baselines. ETA: EOD tomorrow.

Jake: Outreach sent to Sam. Assigned owners: Ana = tech deep-dive & PoC scope; Dylan = procurement one-pager; Maria = account outreach & renewal tracker. I'll run weekly syncs until renewal is resolved. :thumbsup:

Maria: Thanks team. Top priorities: find Priya's successor, get technical conversation scheduled, land a low-risk PoC. Post calendar link here when scheduled.

Jake: Update — Sam tentatively accepted Wed 11am. We'll share an invite once confirmed. :eyes:
